questions.question: Explain the importance of accessibility in tourist destinations.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the importance of accessibility in tourist destinations
  • Accessibility can be physical accessibility like elevators, ramps, pathways;
  • communication accessibility like sign language, braille, audio descriptions and
  • information accessibility like clear signage, websites, multilingual supports etc.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: information accessibility like clear signage, websites, multilingual supports etc.

questions.question: Describe India’s role as a wellness tourism destination.

questions.question: Explain the term"smart tourism".
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the term “smart tourism”
  • It leverages technology to enhance the travel experience, making it more efficient,
  • enjoyable and sustainable. It involves digital platforms, data analytics, artificial
  • intelligence etc.

questions.question: Describe the role of motivation in influencing tourist behavior.
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the role of motivation in influencing tourist behaviour.
  • It drives people to travel and influences their decisions on destination choice, activity
  • selection, duration of stay and budget allocation. Types of motivation includes intrinsic,
  • extrinsic, push factors and pull factors.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: extrinsic, push factors and pull factors.
